D: Absorbed dose given at once (for protons, the proton dose)
D_10: Dose that leaves 10 % of the cells surviving
D_hypoxic: Dose without oxygen that gives the same survival
D_p: Dose at oxygen pressure p that gives the same survival as D in air
D_x: Photon dose that gives the same effect as the proton dose D
E: Biological effect, −ln S summed over the fractions
N: Cells seeded in a flask at dose D
N_0: Cells seeded in a control flask
S: Surviving fraction: the share of cells that can still form a colony
a: Intercept of the fit (ln S at D = 0)
alpha: Linear quadratic coefficient for single track (lethal) damage
beta: Linear quadratic coefficient for two track (repairable) damage
c: Colonies counted in a flask at dose D
c_0: Colonies counted in a control (0 Gy) flask
e: Euler's number, the base of natural logarithms
